name: Navid Mohammadi
availability: Available for remote and international collaboration
principles: Understand the problem before writing the solution
Use AI tools, but review and test what they produce
Communicate clearly and leave knowledge with the team
Choose respectful teams and work worth doing
Take responsibility for the work through delivery

bullets: Since 2009, I have built independent projects for Windows, Linux, and the web, usually staying involved from the first requirements discussion through implementation, debugging, and delivery.
Some projects included custom hardware, so the work covered board design, device interfaces, device software, and the user-facing application.
I choose the language, framework, database, and automation to fit the project instead of forcing every problem into one preferred stack.
Worked on security analysis, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and patch development for government IT infrastructure.
For each issue, I prepared a repeatable example so the technical team could reproduce it, apply the fix, and check the result.
The work covered more than application code; networks, dependencies, configuration, and operational behavior were often part of the same problem.
Co-founded the company and worked directly on technical decisions, implementation, problem solving, and delivery.
Built mobile and web applications that used service APIs and NoSQL databases and had to stay coordinated across several parts.
After the company stopped operating, I continued the remaining projects until its final delivery commitments were complete.

sky-fw.name: Sky-FW
sky-fw.description: An open-source Java framework with shared pieces for client and server applications, built to avoid rewriting the same project plumbing each time.

dream-river.name: Dream-River
dream-river.description: An open-source TypeScript framework for audio-first games that makes Web Audio APIs and sound management easier to work with.

args-dataclass.name: ArgsDataClass
args-dataclass.description: A small Python utility that maps command-line arguments to data classes and cuts down the code needed to parse and validate input.

license-hid.name: License Token & Linux HID Systems
license-hid.description: A Linux HID license-token prototype with Windows and Linux tools for device configuration, diagnostics, and operation.

connected-products.name: Cross-platform products with connected hardware
connected-products.description: Two bilingual web and Android products with one shared UI, server APIs, AI features, and ESP32 devices: one for daily planning and one for an interactive audio experience.

service-platforms.name: Service and case-management platforms
service-platforms.description: Several bilingual systems for appointments, clinical records, consultation, and legal calculations with SMS login, role-based access, persistence, and unit and browser tests.

ai-legal-platform.name: Multi-model consultation platform
ai-legal-platform.description: A bilingual conversation platform with a multi-stage pipeline for answers, peer critique, revision, and scoring, plus durable run state, round-boundary resume, and human review.

hotpaas.name: HoTPaaS
hotpaas.description: An open-source runtime between PaaS and FaaS that accepts, builds, and runs projects over HTTP and exposes process input and output through an API.

midnight-captain.name: Midnight Captain
midnight-captain.description: A lightweight native Linux and container-network service dashboard with a flicker-free ANSI interface and a ports-and-adapters architecture.

vault-index.name: Vault Index
vault-index.description: An offline-first workshop inventory tool with bilingual UI, IndexedDB persistence, and a configurable WebGL display that scales back for reduced motion and software rendering.

claudio.name: Claudio
claudio.description: A single-file Python plugin that evaluates coding-agent tool calls against JSON policies, splits compound shell commands, and records each decision.

ytogh.name: YToGH
ytogh.description: A Rust CLI and library that dispatches file-download workflows through GitHub Actions, follows their state, retrieves chunks, and exposes Android bindings through JNI.

ble-hid-lab.name: ESP32-C3 BLE HID lab
ble-hid-lab.description: BLE keyboard firmware with advertising, a GATT service, HID reports, character-to-keycode mapping, and FreeRTOS tasks, built and flashed through a repeatable container toolchain.

vlc-arm-fix.name: VLC · 32-bit ARM SIGBUS fix
vlc-arm-fix.description: Fixed a video-output alignment fault on armhf by aligning internal storage to max_align_t; the crash came from 64-bit atomics inside pthread_cond_t.

academicProfile.overview: For AI work, I do not rely on tool documentation alone. I read papers, compare methods, and use that research to choose models and design experiments.
academicProfile.continuousPractice: I keep up with papers in AI and data science and attend university workshops or academic sessions when the subject is close to my work.
academicProfile.ongoingPublications: Alongside the accepted paper below, I have submitted several other manuscripts to international journals and they are still under review.
